name: Tuna Fried Rice with Corn
steps: Cook the rice according to package instructions and set aside.
Heat cooking oil in a pan over medium heat.
Add corn and stir‑fry for 2 minutes.
Add drained canned tuna and break it up, stir for another minute.
Stir in cooked rice, soy sauce, and frozen vegetables; fry until everything is hot and lightly browned.
Serve immediately.
image_prompt: fluffy white rice mixed with bright yellow corn kernels, pink chunks of canned tuna, all glossy from soy sauce, lightly browned pieces, steaming hot

name: Black Bean and Corn Rice Bowl with Egg
steps: Cook rice and keep warm.
In a pot, heat a splash of water, add black beans, corn, and frozen vegetables; heat through.
Season with cumin and a pinch of salt.
Boil the eggs for 8 minutes, cool and slice.
Layer rice in a bowl, top with bean‑corn mixture, and arrange sliced eggs on top.
Enjoy while warm.
image_prompt: steamed white rice topped with glossy black beans, golden corn kernels, sliced boiled eggs, dusted with cumin, vibrant green frozen vegetables

name: Egg and Corn Fried Rice
steps: Cook rice, let it cool slightly.
Heat cooking oil in a wok or large pan over medium‑high heat.
Add corn and stir‑fry for 2 minutes.
Push corn to the side, scramble the eggs in the empty space until set.
Add the rice, soy sauce, and combine everything; fry until hot and slightly crispy.
Garnish with chopped green onion and serve.
image_prompt: golden fried rice studded with bright yellow corn and fluffy scrambled eggs, glossy soy sauce coating, sprinkled with chopped green onions

name: Tofu Corn Curry with Rice
steps: Cook rice and keep warm.
In a pot, heat a splash of water, add curry powder and toast briefly.
Stir in coconut milk and bring to a gentle simmer.
Add cubed tofu, corn, and frozen vegetables; simmer 8‑10 minutes until flavors meld.
Season lightly with salt if desired.
Serve the curry over the steamed rice.
image_prompt: steaming white rice beside a creamy orange curry of tofu cubes and sweet corn, speckled with green frozen vegetables, glossy and thick

name: Chicken and Corn Rice Casserole
steps: Cook rice and let it cool slightly.
Place diced chicken breast in a microwave‑safe bowl, add a pinch of salt, and microwave on high for 4 minutes, stirring halfway.
In a large mixing bowl combine rice, cooked chicken, corn, frozen vegetables, and the beaten egg; mix well.
Transfer the mixture to a microwave‑safe casserole dish and microwave on high for 6‑8 minutes, or until the egg is set and the casserole is hot throughout.
Let stand 2 minutes before serving.
image_prompt: baked casserole of fluffy rice mixed with tender chicken pieces, golden corn kernels, and a soft set of egg, speckled with colorful frozen vegetables, bubbling surface

name: Sardine Corn Rice Salad
steps: Cook rice, spread on a plate to cool, then refrigerate until cold.
In a bowl combine the chilled rice, corn kernels, and drained sardines, breaking the sardines into bite‑size pieces.
Season lightly with salt and toss gently.
Fold in sliced green onion just before serving.
Serve cold as a hearty salad.
image_prompt: cool white rice tossed with bright yellow corn kernels and flaky silver sardine fillets, flecks of fresh green onion, a simple, hearty salad
